name: Completeness
description: The extent to which the generated summary covers all the important aspects of the original text
scale: Categorical (complete, mostly complete, partially complete, incomplete)

name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the generated summary contains only information relevant to the topic or question
scale: Categorical (highly relevant, relevant, somewhat relevant, not relevant)

name: Coherence
description: How well the generated summary flows and how understandable it is
scale: Categorical (highly coherent, coherent, somewhat coherent, not coherent)

name: Factuality
description: The extent to which the generated summary is factually accurate
scale: Categorical (factually correct, mostly correct, somewhat correct, incorrect)

name: Conciseness
description: The degree to which the generated summary is brief and to the point
scale: Categorical (highly concise, concise, somewhat concise, not concise)

name: Grammaticality
description: The extent to which the generated summary is grammatically correct
scale: Categorical (highly grammatical, grammatical, somewhat grammatical, not grammatical)
